Description
[/color][/b]
[b]Better Panning[/b] is a tiny quality-of-life mod for Stardew Valley 1.6+ that makes panning feel less awkward without changing the game’s balance too much.
It does [b]two[/b] things:
[list=1]
[*][b]Simple HUD hint[/b] – when you’re holding a pan and walk near a panning spot, a message appears:
[quote][i]“Found a pan spot nearby!”[/i][/quote]
[*][b]Optional extra loot[/b] – if you want a little boost, you can enable an option to drop [b]one extra copy of the vanilla panning treasure[/b] every time you pan. No custom loot tables, no crazy rewards – just a duplicate of whatever the game was already going to give you.

[/list]That’s it. No new items, no map edits, no extra pan spot spawns.
[line][b][color=#00ff00]Features[/color][/b][list]
[*]✅ [b]HUD indicator[/b]
[list]
[*]Only shows when:
[list]
[*]you’re holding a [b]Pan[/b], and
[*]there’s a vanilla panning shimmer on the current map, and
[*]you’re within a reasonable tile distance of it.
[/list][*]The indicator is just a subtle text message at the top of the screen:
[quote]“Found a pan spot nearby!”[/quote][/list][*][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39924/39924-1764929610-253189385.png[/img]﻿
[*]✅ [b]Extra treasure (optional)[/b]
[list]
[*]When enabled, the mod:
[list]
[*]lets the game spawn its normal panning debris/loot,
[*]finds one of the new debris items created by that pan,
[*]clones the underlying item ([code]getOne()[/code]) and drops it at the player’s feet.
[/list][*]You keep the [b]original vanilla loot[/b] plus [b]one extra identical item[/b].
[/list][*]✅ [b]Safe & lightweight[/b]
[list]
[*]No changes to where pan spots spawn.
[*]No custom items or balance-breaking loot tables.
[*]Works entirely on top of vanilla logic using Harmony and SMAPI events.
[/list][/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/39924/39924-1766608841-1447807039.jpg[/img]﻿[line][b][color=#00ff00]Configuration (Generic Mod Config Menu)
[/color][/b]
If you have [b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b] installed, you can configure the mod from the title screen or in-game pause menu.

Current options:
[list]
[*][b]Add extra treasure[/b] (default: ON)
[quote]If enabled, panning drops one extra copy of the vanilla treasure on top of the normal loot.[/quote][*][b]Show HUD indicator[/b] (default: ON)
[quote]If enabled, shows a HUD message when a pan spot is nearby while holding a pan.[/quote][/list]If you don’t use GMCM, you can edit [code]BetterPanning/config.json[/code] manually after running the game once.
[line]
[b][color=#00ff00]Compatibility[/color][/b][list]
[*]Built for Stardew Valley [b]1.6+[/b] and SMAPI [b]4.x[/b].
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods, including other panning or loot mods, since it:
[list]
[*]only reads the vanilla [code]orePanPoint[/code], and
[*]only duplicates the debris items spawned by the game or other mods.
[/list][/list]
